Title: LSJ Mercy for Seth and Memories of Mortality

Messages.Author: Temporis
Messages.Body:
Can a vampire afflicted by Memories of Morality still use Mercy for
Seth to burn an Imbued, or indeed any ally?

Mercy for Seth
Cardtype: Combat
Cost: 1 blood
Discipline: Necromancy
[nec] Strike: put this card on the opposing minion. If this minion is
a mortal, he or she is burned. During his or her untap phase, the
minion with this card takes 1 unpreventable damage. The minion with
this card may burn it as a +1 stealth action.
[NEC] As above, and this strike inflicts 1 damage as well.

Memories of Mortality
Master, 1 Pool
Put this card on a vampire; this vampire cannot attempt to block
allies. Any damage the vampire inflicts on allies is reduced to 0. The

vampire may burn 1 blood during his or her controller's influence
phase to burn this card; he or she then goes into torpor.

As a non-damaging strike, I would argue that they can? However, is a
burn effect synonmous with damage? If it is, I would conclude that
they cannot.

Thanks,

Paul

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
On 9 Jun 2006 02:24:03 -0700, "Temporis" <Reid...@aol.com> wrote:

>Can a vampire afflicted by Memories of Morality still use Mercy for
>Seth to burn an Imbued, or indeed any ally?

Any mortal, yes.
It will not harm other allies until the untap phase damage kicks in.

>Mercy for Seth
>Cardtype: Combat
>Cost: 1 blood
>Discipline: Necromancy
>[nec] Strike: put this card on the opposing minion. If this minion is
>a mortal, he or she is burned. During his or her untap phase, the
>minion with this card takes 1 unpreventable damage. The minion with
>this card may burn it as a +1 stealth action.
>[NEC] As above, and this strike inflicts 1 damage as well.

>Memories of Mortality
>Master, 1 Pool
>Put this card on a vampire; this vampire cannot attempt to block
>allies. Any damage the vampire inflicts on allies is reduced to 0. The
>vampire may burn 1 blood during his or her controller's influence
>phase to burn this card; he or she then goes into torpor.

>As a non-damaging strike, I would argue that they can?

Correct.
At inferior, it does not inflict damage.

>However, is a burn effect synonmous with damage?

No.
